The Supermicro AOC-STG-i2T Rev. 2.01 is a dual-port 10 Gigabit Ethernet network adapter designed for high-performance server and data center environments. Powered by the Intel X540 Ethernet controller, it delivers reliable, low-latency connectivity over standard Cat6a/Cat7 copper cabling, offering a cost-effective 10GBASE-T solution.

Supporting the PCI Express Gen2 x8 interface, this NIC ensures optimized throughput for virtualization, cloud computing, and heavy data workloads. The adapter is compatible with all major operating systems and server platforms, making it ideal for enterprise deployment.


Key Features:

  • Model: AOC-STG-i2T Rev. 2.01

  • Controller: Intel X540

  • Interface: PCI Express 2.1 x8

  • Ports: 2 x 10GBASE-T RJ45 (Copper)

  • Speed: 10 Gbps per port, full duplex

  • Cabling: Cat6a/Cat7 (up to 100m)

  • Advanced Features:

    • Jumbo Frame Support

    • VLAN Tagging

    • TCP/UDP/IP Offloading

    • iSCSI Boot

    • IEEE 802.3az (Energy Efficient Ethernet)

  • Form Factor: Low-profile and full-height brackets included

  • Compatibility: Windows, Linux, VMware, FreeBSD

Ideal For:

  • Enterprise & SMB Servers

  • Virtualization Platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox)

  • Storage and Backup Systems

  • High-Speed LAN Upgrades

  • Cloud and Data Center Infrastructure
